title: Leaving Calhoun for Pittsburgh and the Arban book
summary: He joined his brother Theophilus in Pittsburgh, where an insurance man gave him a large Arban trumpet method book in 1924.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up the horn: first instrument and the trombone

blocks.x: when I came -- when I came out of Calhoun, came -- left Calhoun, came to Pittsburgh.
Well, I had a brother living there with his family.

Uh-huh, and as soon as we could I got a hold of a trumpet, and one of those big Arbon books, Italian insurance man, he came in one day and saw me playing and he said, 'You play the trumpet?' I said, well, he said, 'Play something.' So I played. He said, 'I'm going to bring you something.' Next time he came to collect my brother's insurance he brought this big Arbon book, and I still have it, and that was 1924.

Well, it's a music book. In other words, it's a (snaps fingers) exercises over everything. Everything. It's about that thick. He said, 'If you learn to play anything in this book,' he said, 'You don't have any more worries,' and he's right.
